messages:
Jules P: Hi folks  First-day snag: clicked the Okta invite and it started the device-trust flow, then failed with 'device not recognized'. I'm on a company-managed MacBook (DEP/JAMF). Also tried to enroll a passkey via the QR code flow (phone -> camera) and the QR never decodes (camera shows 'invalid challenge'). 1Password hasn't shown an invite yet. Who should I poke?

Tess (IT): Welcome! Device-trust failures often happen if the DEP serial hasn't synced to our asset DB. Can you DM me the device serial? For the QR passkey: try switching to the manual code option in the Okta app (there's a "Use code instead" link) or use Okta Verify app camera permissions.

Jules P: Serial is C02ABC1234GH. Tried manual code but the app says "challenge expired". I restarted device and re-requested invite.

Tess (IT): Got it. I see the device is pending in JAMF and the serial hadn't propagated to our asset sync job (it retries on a 15m schedule). I kicked a manual sync and reissued the invite with a fresh QR/challenge. Also created a 24h bypass token in case the QR still fails. Ticket IT-55555 opened.

ops-bot: [automated] Ticket IT-55555 created 4dd "DEP serial sync + QR passkey challenge expired for Jules P". Assigned Tess (IT). ETA 1h.

Rae - People Ops: Jules, I added you to onboarding-temp so you get calendars/docs while IT finishes. For 1Password we had a SCIM sync hiccup this morning that delayed seats; I filed PL-1188 with vendor. I'll ping them to prioritize your seat. Do you need repo access right away?

Jules P: Docs/calendar first please. Repo access after SSO is stable. I can try the new QR now if you reissued it.

Tess (IT): Reissued and DM'd you the new QR + bypass token. If the mobile camera keeps failing, open the Okta app, choose "Use code instead" and paste this short code: `X7-9K-PL`. That bypass will allow enrollment and then we can attach the device-trust profile later.

Jules P: Used the code, enroll worked! I see Okta session active in browser. Still no 1Password invite yet but I can access the onboarding docs. Thanks.

Tess (IT): Great. Follow-up: I confirmed JAMF serial now in our asset DB and flagged the device as trusted. I'll close IT-55555 once SCIM vendor confirms 1Password seat.

ops-bot: [automated] Ticket IT-55555 updated 4dd "Asset sync completed; passkey enroll success".

Rae - People Ops: 1Password seat provisioned (PL-1188 resolved) 389 you should have the invite now. Welcome aboard Jules! If you want help swapping SMS to hardware key later, ping IT.

Jules P: Got 1Password invite and set up vaults. All green 44d. Appreciate the quick loop here.
